svg.title: Merlion Express — first-release client demo architecture
svg.desc: Hybrid MySQL and JSONL architecture. Structured and unstructured ingestion publish exact facts, cited files and a semantic index. Python HTTP services perform order RAG and weekly reporting, persist sessions and validate citations or abstain. React screens use draft API routes. Dashed components are pending implementation.
